name: logo panels four-screw replaceable mounting stack
detail: two outward-accessible M3 screws per panel; four clear axes, solid shell-webbed bosses, 5.5 mm nominal insert overlap, and zero installed interference

name: Wi-Fi dock rounded-lip insertion geometry
detail: Ø30.0 mm hub enters a 29.5 mm rounded mouth with 0.25 mm nominal movement per arm and seats in a 31.0 mm cavity; stem movement is 0.25 mm/arm

name: RUTM30 reference provenance

name: Ethernet topology concurrency
detail: Two native router ports exist; one is normally occupied by the internal Mac link. Both extension positions are serviceable, but two simultaneous external links plus the Mac require an approved active switch/topology change.
